SELECT MIN(id) AS id,
name,
campus_id,
building_id,
COUNT(worker_id) AS worker_count,
MAX(enabled) AS enabled,
MAX(create_time) AS create_time,
MAX(update_time) AS update_time
FROM task_template
AND campus_id = #{dto.campusId}
AND building_id = #{dto.buildingId}
AND enabled = #{dto.enabled}
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dto.name},'%')
GROUP BY name, campus_id, building_id
